audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls his E 'Powder Kegs' and the content layer names none of his abilities at all — everything is 'barrel', 'his W', 'his R global'.
audit.why: Riot's names are Trial by Fire (P), Parrrley (Q), Remove Scurvy (W), Powder Keg (E, singular) and Cannon Barrage (R).
audit.corrected: Singular Powder Keg used in the full layer and real names written through the content spikes, foe wants and level-6 why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike describes 'his R global' with no name and no cooldown.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120 with effectively map-wide range; naming the cooldown makes the roam and the all-in window trackable.
audit.corrected: Spike and level-6 why now name Cannon Barrage and Remove Scurvy with its 22s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy is described only as a slow-cleanse; its heal is never mentioned, so no anti-heal timing is given.
audit.why: Riot's description: eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health. It is both the cleanse and a heal on a 22s to 14s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block and the third Don't now cover both halves and the Grievous Wounds timing.

audit.why: Parrrley is 4.5s flat, Remove Scurvy 22s at rank 1 down to 14s, Cannon Barrage 160/140/120 — Remove Scurvy is the only punishable one.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the cooldown breakdown and Key Ability Interactions.

edits.before: Pop barrels — build a little armor, out-scale him. Malphite wins the Powder Kegs cooldown windows.
edits.after: Kill his kegs — build a little armour, out-scale him. Malphite wins the Remove Scurvy windows.

edits.before: Deny barrels and out-scale him. Track Powder Kegs before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Deny Powder Kegs and out-scale him. Track Remove Scurvy before every commit and hold the wave your side.

edits.before: Gangplank wins by landing Powder Kegs, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Gangplank wins by chaining Powder Kegs, cleansing your slow, and kiting you off the wave.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Remove Scurvy (W): 22s at rank 1, 14s at rank 5 — it cleanses your Q slow and heals, so engage after he spends it. - Parrrley (Q): 4.5s, unpunishable poke. - Cannon Barrage (R): 160/140/120. - Your ultimate: 130s.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. When it is down — R-W-E him.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy (W, 22s at rank 1) cleanses your Seismic Shard slow — commit only after he burns it.

edits.before: Trading with your passive shield down — that shield IS your trade margin; without it you are paying full price.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy heals as well as cleanses — Grievous Wounds goes on before the extended trade, not after.

edits.before: Walk up with Granite Shield full and Q-poke him off a barrel placement before his crit passive and chain are online.
edits.after: Walk up with Granite Shield full and Seismic Shard him off a Powder Keg placement before Trial by Fire is online.

edits.before: His R global plus barrel-chain detonation outranges your whole kit — your R closes distance but he kites it with W cleansing your Q slow.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage (R) plus a Powder Keg chain outranges your whole kit — your R closes the gap, but Remove Scurvy strips your Q slow and he kites out.

edits.before: Chain-detonate barrels for poke and use the move speed to dodge your Q and walk-up
edits.after: Chain-detonate Powder Kegs for poke and ride the move speed out of your Q range

edits.before: Cleanse your Q slow with W and heal back any E/W trade chip you land
edits.after: Cleanse your Q slow with Remove Scurvy (W) and heal the chip back

edits.before: His R is global and his W cleanses your Q slow, so your R engage gets nullified while his barrels detonate from range you can't close.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage is global and Remove Scurvy (22s at rank 1) strips your Q slow, so your engage is peeled while his kegs poke.

notes: Whether Remove Scurvy can strip Unstoppable Force's knock-up is not answerable from the kit files (needsResearch.cleansable is empty), so no claim was made either way — logged as unverified. Malphite's kit derives a 'grounding' flag on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam that Riot's descriptions do not support; no grounding claim written. Gangplank's kit derives a trueDamage flag on Cannon Barrage that his description does not mention — not used.
